comparison.objective: Seat a magnetic detacher on a security tag and pull its pin from a cuff; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Detacher alignment, maintained seating, and coordinated pin extraction versus coaxial driver/wrench engagement and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires clutch release, specified pin withdrawal, and hands-off clearance; candidate requires angle tolerance, seated nuts, three retained cycles, and drift control.
comparison.reason: The record coordinates two actions on a clutch release, but it does not measure threaded adjustment, jam-nut reaction, or retained motion.
